question: Who among the following sacrificed her life along with 363 others for the protection of khejri' trees in Khejrali village near Jodhpur in Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amrita Devi Bishnoi**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amrita Devi Bishnoi and 363 other Bishnois** sacrificed their lives to protect Khejri trees in Khejarli village, Rajasthan in 1730. 
 
• Amrita Devi Bishnoi was a **member of the Bishnoi community** and an environmentalist. 
 
• The Bishnoi community c**onsidered Khejri trees sacred. **
 
• In 1730, **Maharaja Abhay Singh **of Marwar ordered the felling of **Khejri trees to build his new palace. **
 
• **Amrita Devi led a movement to protest the felling of the trees. **
 
• She famously said she would give her life to save the trees. 
 
• According to legend, the king's men decapitated Amrita Devi after she put her arms around a tree to prevent it from being felled. 
 
• In the Khejarli massacre**, Amrita Devi's three daughters and 363 other Bishnois were killed. **
 
• In memory of Amrita Devi, the "**Amrita Devi Bishnoi National Award for Wildlife Conservation**" was established.
